faqs.question: What services do you provide?
faqs.answer: I specialize in AI-powered applications, intelligent automation, chatbots, CRM systems, full-stack web applications, REST API development, and machine learning solutions.

faqs.question: Can you build AI applications?
faqs.answer: Yes. I build AI applications using Python, Flask, Claude AI, Groq, and machine learning frameworks — from intelligent document processing to predictive analytics.

faqs.question: Do you work remotely?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. I work fully remotely and collaborate with clients across different time zones using modern communication and project management tools.

faqs.question: Can you join startup teams?
faqs.answer: Yes. As Co-Founder of NexusAI, I understand startup challenges and can contribute as a technical founder, lead developer, or AI specialist.

faqs.question: Do you provide long-term support?
faqs.answer: Yes. I provide ongoing maintenance, feature development, and technical support for all projects I build.

faqs.question: How can I see your previous work?
faqs.answer: Explore the Featured Products section which showcases ExamMate AI, Smart Campus System, NexusAI Portfolio, Artora, and CareGroup with detailed case studies.
